quality_findings.finding: 96 catalogue entries include 13 exact ArcGIS layer alias pairs. Other semantic overlap remains unresolved; no claim of 96 distinct datasets.
PropertyPeek records 613 field-description rows for 33 datasets; field labels and samples are not complete typed schemas.
PropertyPeek named source extracts were not supplied. Fresh bounded responses in this pack are separate evidence.
PropertyPeek sample act_blocks is CAMPBELL and RETIRED despite a Kingston filename. Validate geography and lifecycle before inclusion.
Ten DA activity sample rows represent two application identifiers. Preserve child rows and deduplicate project identity.
Completed DA refers to the application process; a captured record says Approval Conditional. It does not establish construction completion.
The current crime catalogue is a blobby workbook asset, with stated coverage ending 30 June 2025. Direct workbook captured; no SODA crime row feed assumed.
Flood geometry exceeded a 1 MB response bound even for one feature. Attribute sample retained; complete authoritative geometry not yet staged.
Metadata access and one feature do not establish source coverage, recency or permitted reuse.
PropertyPeek cached overview live count conflicts with 36 text TRUE entries. Reconcile formulas/types before relying on summary counts.
The risk library is a 2021 reference; generic categorical ratings remain source annotations, not property findings.
Twenty acceptance specifications remain unexecuted; exact financial fixtures require an explicit precision policy.
